events.title: Anomagram is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Anomagram is taking part in Steam Next Fest, running until October 26 at 10 AM Pacific. The demo is free to download and play. It's midnight, and a company-issued terminal feeds you short videos to approve or report, one by one. The demo covers the first three nights of the eight-night contract and takes about 15–30 minutes. The anomalies are drawn at random, so the next run will be a different night. Interface available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean. T

events.title: The demo is out
events.summary: The Anomagram demo is now available. You can download and play it right now. The demo covers the first three nights of the full game's eight-night contract, and takes about 15 minutes. The anomalies are drawn at random, so the same three nights play differently next time. Interface available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean. The full game is planned for Q4 2026. Add it to your wishlist to get notified at launch. https://store.steampowered.com/app/5254350/

events.title: The Anomagram Demo store page is live
events.summary: The store page for the Anomagram demo is now up. The demo covers the first three nights of the full game's eight-night contract. Six posts arrive each night, and the three nights take about 20 minutes. The anomalies are drawn at random, so the same three nights play differently next time. Interface in English and Japanese. Coming soon The demo becomes downloadable soon. For now you can follow the demo page - you'll get a notification the moment it goes live. The full game is planned for Q4 2026.
